name: Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 17
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 17 is a standard Apple iPhone 17 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It uses a flameproof (Ex db) housing. The phone runs iOS 27.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T4 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: Flameproof Ex db enclosure (dust: Ex tb). Specific conditions (IECEx EPS 26.0046X): Ta −20 to +50 °C; no repair of flameproof joints; screws min. property class A4-70; original parts only; protect glass windows from impact > 2 J; do not open in hazardous location; battery charging only outside hazardous location; SIM can be fitted by the user in a safe area; EX-ATEXXO-STRAP accessory original part only.
